description:
**Original Webtoon:**    
R19: [RIDI](https://ridibooks.com/books/505105846)   
R15: [RIDI](https://ridibooks.com/books/505105847)

Yoon Seo-Ho, the fourth-generation only son of the Yoon family. Believing he was the only one in the world and living solely for his own self-importance, he eventually ended up banished to a rural school. There, he meets Lee Bo-Deum, who hovers around him like a stalker with her soft appearance . To get rid of this annoying senior, Yoon Seo-Ho does not hesitate to use harsh words and actions…

As time goes by, Bo-deum keeps appearing in his dreams, and he feels like he will go crazy if he can’t see that blank face. So, after much deliberation, he decided to give Bo-Deum a chance to confess.

“Be my model for the sports massage competition.”
“I have no intention of dating anyone… Senior, are you kidding me??”

This pathetic stalker has only wanted my body all this time?!
